intent.description: What the message asks for: a WebAir search (also any question about flights, fares or rules, which repeats or changes the last search), a quote of one fare, the purchase of the open quote, a question the conversation itself answers, or the end of the conversation.

search.description: One WebAir search, with origin, nonstop preference and cabin null when the request leaves them unstated, or null when the request cannot be one WebAir search.

needs_travel_profile.description: True when the request leaves the departure airport unstated, or refers to the person's usual preferences, so the travel profile they grant should fill what is unstated.

fare_id.description: For a quote of a fare an earlier turn offered or quoted: its id, copied exactly from known_fares; null when the quote follows a search in this turn, or for every other intent.

note.description: For a purchase: the one-sentence question the person is asked before the simulated purchase, naming the fare, the route, the date and the total. For a question or the end: what to tell the person. Null for a search or a quote.
